hints.title: Free Backward Swaps
hints.text: Once you pay to swap forward to any position, people behind you swap with you for free, allowing backward movements at zero additional cost.

hints.title: Prefix Minimum Cost
hints.text: To reach position i, you can swap directly with person i or reach any person at or before i and step backward for free.

hints.title: Running Minimum
hints.text: The minimum cost to reach index i is simply the prefix minimum of the cost array from index 0 up to i.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass computes running prefix minimums.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recalculating prefix minimums repeatedly takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant auxiliary space beyond the output array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that free backward movements turn the problem into running prefix minimums.
